args.question: What does the cardholder say about receipt of the service or goods?

args.narrative: The order of USD 113.80 on 2026-01-05 was delivered by USPS on 2026-01-10 (delivery proof attached, matching amount). The merchant holds no cancellation record for this order.

args.explanation: 13.1 chargeback; cardholder said they cancelled. Merchant had a receipt and a USPS delivery proof dated 2026-01-10 matching the amount, and no cancellation record. Represented with receipt and delivery proof; issuer accepted the representment. Merchant keeps the sale; only the USD 15 chargeback fee is lost.
